drivers.name: IntegrateIT Garage
drivers.summary: Universal relay garage-door control with contact feedback, travel supervision, left-open alerts, close warnings, safe simulation, and resilient state handling.
features: One-, two-, or three-relay garage control
Closed and opened contact supervision with debounce
Travel timeout, sensor-conflict, and left-open events
Configurable close warning and safe unknown-state behavior
Test Mode blocks physical outputs while simulating every major state
In-place Composer updates preserve bindings and programming
requirements: A compatible Control4 relay or relay-capable controller output
A position contact is strongly recommended for supervised operation
Composer Pro access for initial bindings and future in-place updates
limitations: Release Candidate: simulator verified; representative opener hardware acceptance is still pending.
The driver does not bypass an opener's own photo-eye, obstruction, or entrapment protection.
With no contact sensors, state is inferred from commands and travel timers rather than measured position.

drivers.summary: Production-grade Jewish calendar automation with candle lighting, Havdalah, sunset, holidays, Hebrew date, Omer, resilient caching, and safe simulation.
features: Candle lighting, sunset, Havdalah, and configurable early/late events
Hebrew date, holidays, Shabbat, Yom Tov, Omer, and weekly parsha status
US ZIP Code or worldwide GeoNames location selection
Diaspora and Israel calendar modes
Resilient cache, retry, recovery event, and safe Test Date simulation
In-place Composer updates preserve properties and programming

Test Mode is for inspection and simulation; it intentionally disables real timed event firing.

drivers.name: MantelMount MM815 (Bond Bridge) by IntegrateIT
drivers.summary: PTZ-style control of a MantelMount MM815 motorized TV mount over Bond Bridge — nudge, drive-to-limit, true hold-to-move, six favorites, and TV-follow (auto Deploy/Stow with TV power). Bond auto-discovery + health, position state variables/events, per-controller licensing, and over-the-air updates.
features: PTZ-style nudge, drive-to-limit, stop, and true hold-to-move control
Six programmable MantelMount memory positions
TV-follow automation for automatic Deploy and Stow
Bond Bridge discovery, connection testing, and health polling
Position variables and movement lifecycle events for programming
In-place Composer updates preserve properties, bindings, and programming
requirements: Bond Bridge IP address, local API token, and learned mount device ID
The MM815 command mapping discovered or entered during commissioning
Reliable LAN reachability between the Control4 controller and Bond Bridge
Composer Pro access for bindings, testing, and future in-place updates
limitations: Release Candidate: simulator verified; representative MM815 and Bond Bridge acceptance evidence is not yet attached to this release.
Movement position is inferred from commands and configured settle time rather than measured absolute mount telemetry.
Availability and naming of learned actions depend on the Bond device configuration.

drivers.name: IntegrateIT Safe Power Cycle
drivers.summary: Dealer tool that safely power-cycles bound relays: turn OFF, wait a configurable delay, turn ON — with a two-step confirmation guard, an hourly rate limit, and full audit events for rebooting AV racks, network gear, and headless appliances from Control4.
features: One-to-four relay outputs power-cycled together (off, wait, on)
Two-step arm-then-cycle confirmation blocks accidental reboots
Configurable off duration from 1 to 300 seconds
Hourly rate limit caps how often a rack can be cycled
Latching or momentary relay behavior for held or pulsed loads
Cycle Started / Completed / Blocked / Powered Off / Powered On events for full audit programming

compatibility.label: Navigator
compatibility.value: Headless — driven by programming and Actions

requirements: One to four Control4 relay or relay-capable controller outputs wired to the load's power
A relay contact rated for the switched load, or a contactor the relay drives
Composer Pro access for initial relay bindings and future in-place updates
limitations: Release Candidate: simulator verified; representative relay-hardware acceptance is still pending.
The driver switches relays only — it does not verify that the downstream load actually lost and regained power.
Momentary mode assumes the load latches its own power state from a button-style pulse.

drivers.name: IntegrateIT Generic TCP Toolkit
drivers.summary: Dealer-configurable raw TCP/IP control for any LAN device: four labeled command slots plus a raw send, ASCII or hex payloads, selectable line endings, persistent or on-demand sockets, and response events — with destination, payload-size, and buffer safeguards. MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
features: Raw TCP client to any host and port on the LAN
Four labeled command slots plus a raw-payload send, all fireable from Composer programming
ASCII/UTF-8 or hex-byte payloads with selectable CR / LF / CR+LF line endings
Persistent socket with auto-reconnect, or on-demand connect-per-send
Connected, Disconnected, Response Received, and Connection Failed events
LAN-only destination safeguard, payload-size cap, bounded response buffer, and audit logging
MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing with lenient or strict enforcement

compatibility.label: Control
compatibility.value: Raw TCP to any LAN host and port

compatibility.label: Payloads
compatibility.value: ASCII/UTF-8 or hex, with optional line endings

requirements: Control4 OS 3.0.0 or newer
The target device must accept a raw TCP connection on a known port
For production, an IntegrateIT license key bound to this controller
limitations: Release Candidate: simulator verified; representative device acceptance on a controller is still pending.
Outbound raw TCP only, with no TLS: this is not a server and payloads are sent in the clear, so use it on trusted LAN segments.
WAN destinations are refused unless Allow WAN Destinations is explicitly set to Yes.
